verdict.rationale: Motion documents a public API for tasks/projects and a Zapier integration that could theoretically bridge to CRMs, but there is no direct evidence of native Salesforce/HubSpot connectors or of booking data flowing automatically into a CRM without manual setup. missing for 10: native Salesforce/HubSpot integration docs, concrete example of booking-to-CRM automation, independent confirmation the Zapier path works reliably for this use case.
